chk.text: Michiko Konda, the daughter of the warlord Konda, abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage, and she meets the thief Toshi Umezawa along the way.
The Myojin of Life's Web has her captured, hoping her death would end the war, but Toshi saves her from it.
In the war's twentieth year she frees the scion Kyodai, and together they defeat O-Kagachi and Konda, and Kyodai strips the Konda family of their hereditary rule.

bok.text: Michiko Konda employs Toshi, who is beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
At Minamo she speaks with Mochi and learns that what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, while Hidetsugu attacks the academy.
Toshi then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.

sok.text: Michiko Konda sends a kanji message to Toshi when Eiganjo has fallen and the soratami are conquering in Takenuma and Jukai, and she and Toshi must find a way to stave off the kami's impending victory.
Michiko frees the spirit in the Taken One, who is named Kyodai, and as O-Kagachi manifests all eight heads, the two merge and defeat him, biting off his last heads.
The sisters take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology, and the war ends with Michiko and Kyodai as guardians of the veil.

neo.text: Michiko Konda bonds with Kyodai, ending the Kami War and guiding Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.
Their union creates the Sisters, who destroy O-Kagachi and take his place, and it ends when Michiko dies, though Kyodai keeps a bond with each emperor.
Michiko is posthumously styled the first emperor of a new Kamigawa.

j22.text: Michiko Konda leaves home, vowing not to return until she can find out how to bring her father back to his senses and Kamigawa is again at peace.
